project.name: synthetic-maintainer-loop
project.description: A public-safe end-to-end example for triaging, reviewing, and handing off an AI asset maintenance batch.
project.maintainer_intent: Show how a maintainer can move from issue triage to preflight, review, decision gate, and resumable handoff without exposing private assets.
